visual_identity.core_identity: A colossal subterranean worm whose immense segmented body and circular tooth-filled maw can fill an entire mine tunnel.
visual_identity.silhouette: Huge cylindrical segmented body emerging through tunnel space, front dominated by round open maw.
visual_identity.head_features: No separate skull; front is a circular muscular mouth ringed with inward-pointing teeth.
visual_identity.body_shape: Extremely thick worm body with repeated broad segments and long unseen continuation into tunnel.
visual_identity.limb_structure: No legs, arms, fins, or wings; the entire body is a massive cylindrical worm.
visual_identity.surface: Large simple segmented plates or folds; minimal fine texture.

accuracy_checks: scale is obvious from tunnel geometry

known_failure_modes.symptom: worm gains dragonlike skull or horns
known_failure_modes.correction: restore circular maw with no separate head shape
replace with round radial mouth opening

known_failure_modes.symptom: maw fills with tiny coloring clutter

scene_identity.size_impression: Gargantuan and tunnel-filling; architecture must visibly establish scale.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Body remains supported by tunnel, earth, or cavern opening while emerging or coiling.
environment_fit: underground caverns with strong scale cues
